overview_description.description:
Safety and Control Systems, LLC “SBK”, LLC is a start-up company that is engaged in development and implementation of safety systems and computer-controlled monitoring for public transport. One of our recent developments is upgrade of systems preventing passengers from being pressed by automatic closing doors to enhance their reliability and functioning degree of accuracy. 
In particular, the engineers of our company needed to solve the problem of stability and reliability of power transmission at the door of transport to provide power to the sensitive edge. In modern transport, a contact method of transmitting electrical energy to a door (wire, cable or contact group) is used.
